Obsidian Flames

Released August 11, 2023 · 230 cards

StandardExpanded

Obsidian Flames is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Scarlet & Violet series, released in English on August 11, 2023. Its main set has 197 cards, plus 33 secret rares numbered beyond the set (230 in total). It includes 210 Pokémon, 19 Trainer and 1 Energy cards, and is legal in the Standard and Expanded formats.
